big_case.notes: Fact-bound Title VII COVID-19 vaccine religious-accommodation and Rule 56(d) late-expert-disclosure dispute from a single healthcare employee, decided by a magistrate judge on summary judgment and affirmed by the Fourth Circuit in a two-paragraph unpublished per curiam opinion without oral argument. Respondent waived its response and the Court denied certiorari without comment after one distribution.
